title: Kuro's 3D model at reception
caption: Your kuro-3 pick (Review kuro-meshy-orig-3) now stands behind the head office reception counter on day 1 and day 2, in the game's idle, at Mio's height. The black under her chin and jaw is repainted in skin; nothing else in the model or texture changed.
